gloss: outgoing call history; sent message log

definitions.gloss: outgoing call history; sent message log
definitions.explanation: A record of calls made or messages sent from a phone or device. A standard feature on mobile phones and communication apps.

examples.japanese: {発信履歴|はっしんりれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the outgoing call history.

examples.japanese: {発信履歴|はっしんりれき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧かけ⟦{直|なお}した→直す：00869_naosu⟧。
examples.english: I called the number again from the outgoing call history.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発信履歴|はっしんりれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{形跡|けいせき}→形跡：17133_keiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Looking at my phone's outgoing call history, there were traces of multiple calls to an unknown number last night.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{発信|はっしん}→発信：04895_hasshin⟧ (transmission, sending) and ⟦{履歴|りれき}→履歴：09334_rireki⟧ (history, log, record). A practical technology term that anyone with a smartphone encounters regularly.

USAGE:
Primarily used in the context of phone calls and messaging. On Japanese smartphones, the call log typically shows {発信履歴|はっしんりれき} (outgoing), ⟦{着信履歴|ちゃくしんりれき}→着信履歴：17362_chakushinrireki⟧ (incoming), and ⟦{不在着信|ふざいちゃくしん}→不在着信：08041_fuzaichakushin⟧ (missed calls) as separate views.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発信履歴|はっしんりれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the outgoing call log
- {発信履歴|はっしんりれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削除|さくじょ}→削除：04171_sakujo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to delete the outgoing call history
- {発信履歴|はっしんりれき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}する→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧: to call from the outgoing log
- {発信履歴|はっしんりれき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: outgoing call list

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{着信履歴|ちゃくしんりれき}→着信履歴：17362_chakushinrireki⟧: incoming call history — the record of calls received
- {通話履歴|つうわりれき}: call history — a broader term covering both incoming and outgoing calls
- ⟦{不在着信|ふざいちゃくしん}→不在着信：08041_fuzaichakushin⟧: missed call — a call that was not answered
- ⟦{履歴|りれき}→履歴：09334_rireki⟧: history, log — the general term for any recorded history (browsing history, call history, etc.)
